pr_title: fix(compiler): record correct end of expression
pr_body:
This commit fixes a bug with the expression parser wherein the end index
of an expression node was recorded as the start index of the next token,
not the end index of the current token.

Closes #33477
Closes angular/vscode-ng-language-service#433

# 🐞 bug report

### Affected Package

@angular/compiler


### Is this a regression?

No

### Description

The expression parser leaves trailing whitespace when generating some expressions ASTs. This is already a known issue:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/8b5ca670ad74ccc6ca1edd0eea06b9520143d557/packages/compiler/test/render3/r3_ast_absolute_span_spec.ts#L60-L68

This extra whitespace should probably be stripped so that e.g. diagnostic messages do not have trailing whitespace. See https://github.com/angular/vscode-ng-language-service/issues/433 for an example of this affecting the language service.

This is unrelated to #31898.

## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/8b5ca670ad74ccc6ca1edd0eea06b9520143d557/packages/compiler/test/render3/r3_ast_absolute_span_spec.ts#L60-L68

## 🔥 Exception or Error

N/A

## 🌍  Your Environment

**Angular Version:**
```
9.0.0-next.*
```

**Anything else relevant?**

N/A
comments:
Taking a quick look, this should be fairly easy to fix by modifying the `span()` method of the expression parser to mark the end of an expression span using the current expression rather than using the start of the next expression:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/5666d116336e3e0d5426c5d8f6a91c178d797523/packages/compiler/src/expression_parser/parser.ts#L253-L258

Maybe by adding a new field on a token to mark its end:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/5666d116336e3e0d5426c5d8f6a91c178d797523/packages/compiler/src/expression_parser/lexer.ts#L36-L39

review_comments:
this check shouldn't be necessary since `TemplateBinding = VariableBinding | ExpressionBinding`
but please add a comment that clarifies that this is an ExpressionBinding

I meant for this to be a comment in code, so that it is easier to see what the definition of `ExpressionBinding` is just by going to the definition if reading in an editor with tsserver. Let me know if you would prefer a simple `else` with a comment

I think the editor is able to infer that `binding` in this `else` scope is `ExpressionBinding`, so if you right click and select "Go to type definition" it'd bring you to `ExpressionScope`.
That said, I guess it's ok to leave it as is. Thanks!
